title: The OpenCode model rule accepted a model with an empty part, such as opencode-go/, against the canonical key
resolution: The rule now requires a non-empty provider and model around the first slash; tests cover active findings and passes and an unaffected archive

title: The same-harness fallback and the replacement scenarios ignored whether a reviewer may take the role, so a barred reviewer could block the fallback
resolution: Governance, protocol, and skill count only reviewers allowed in the role; the delta modifies Unavailable reviewer and No reviewer of another harness

title: Coordinator step 1 skipped and replaced reviewers without the role test of the reviewer assignment
resolution: The step skips reviewers barred from the role and assigns only a replacement that may take the role

title: The spec delta and the protocol did not say that both parts of an OpenCode model must be non-empty
resolution: Both now name provider/model with both parts non-empty, and a scenario covers an OpenCode model with an empty part

title: The record said both contract documents had no breaking change, though four documents are checked
resolution: The record now names the four contract documents

title: Tasks and design listed the spec changes without the two requirements and new scenarios added after pass 1
resolution: Task 1.2 and design D6 list every added and modified requirement and the new scenarios

title: The record called the coverage of the scripts unmeasured instead of measuring it
resolution: The record gives the coverage command for the two scripts and its measured result

title: Reviewer assignment said needs network access where the other requirements say depends on external facts
resolution: The requirement and its scenario now tie network access to a review that depends on external facts

title: The per-alias tests did not check that validate passes and that archived records stay byte-identical
resolution: Each per-alias test asserts validate exits 0 and compares every archived file after reviewers and index
